name: John Gorrie Memorial Bridge
facts: John Gorrie Bridge opened on Armistice Day, November 11, 1935, with Florida Governor David Sholtz cutting the ribbon to launch the Florida West Coast Scenic Highway.
The original 1935 bridge featured a rotating section, allowing tall-masted ships to pass while vehicles crossed the Apalachicola Bay.
Rebuilt in 1988, the current John Gorrie Bridge replaced the 1935 structure, continuing to carry US 98 and US 319 between Apalachicola and Eastpoint.
